note: OBSERVED COVARIATE AUDIT ONLY -- no era variable is ever added to V or A, judged by any LLM, or fit into anything feeding the closure curve.
container: the subreddit's own posting stream; the ordinal is when the post entered it (FREEZE ADDENDUM 4 analogue for a corpus whose items have no sibling-set container)

coverage.note: unmatched rows are DROPPED from each readout, never imputed

structural_note: y strata on (length_bin x format x topic), NOT on time, so era is free to predict y; a null here is a real null.
T_convention_in_this_file: every T here is the AUC of the seed-MEAN dense prediction vector (the seed ENSEMBLE), because the stratified and stacked readouts need ONE score column. The campaign's quoted T is the mean-over-seeds-of-the-AUC in round0.py / cells.T_by_seed; the two are never mixed in one figure. On HONEST they read .7469 (ensemble) and .7377 (mean-of-AUCs).

created_utc.direction: UPSTREAM, container-ordinal -- absolute position in the subreddit's posting stream. The FREEZE ADDENDUM 4 channel for this corpus. Not matched away by the y-definition (which strata on length/format/topic, not time), so a null here is informative.

era_rank_pct.direction: UPSTREAM -- the same ordinal, rank-normalised so the readout is scale-free and robust to the scrape's calendar coverage.

post_year.direction: UPSTREAM, coarse era -- the level at which forum conventions and meme stock actually turn over.

post_month_of_y.direction: UPSTREAM, seasonal -- holiday and event joke cycles.

post_hour_utc.direction: UPSTREAM, submission timing -- when a post enters the stream governs how much of the audience ever sees it; a classic vote-mechanics nuisance with no plausible craft component.

post_dow.direction: UPSTREAM, submission timing -- same family as post_hour_utc.

joint_era_model.na_encoding: missing timestamps encoded as -1 so the tree can isolate them; the per-variable readouts above drop them instead.

stacked_increment_over_era.note: grouped 5-fold OOF logistic stack on HONEST; the increment the dense arm adds over the whole named era family in one scalar (FREEZE ADDENDUM 1 stacked readout; does not degenerate as the nuisance set grows).
